name: friendly-trader-film-production
description: Friendly Trader launch film composition (Fable). Dependencies stay local to this folder.

scripts.studio: npm run prepare-assets && remotion studio src/index.ts
scripts.render:landscape: npm run prepare-assets && remotion render src/index.ts FriendlyTraderFilmLandscape out/friendly-trader-film-landscape.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18
scripts.render:portrait: npm run prepare-assets && remotion render src/index.ts FriendlyTraderFilmPortrait out/friendly-trader-film-portrait.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18
scripts.still: npm run prepare-assets && remotion still src/index.ts FriendlyTraderFilmLandscape out/still.png --frame
